title: Juan and Roberto made our Seville tour unforgettable!
text: Juan and Roberto were warm, funny, and so knowledgeable about their city. They made Seville's history easy and fun to follow, and we loved hearing about the Star Wars filming at the Plaza de España. They kept checking that we were comfortable, were patient with every question, and were professional the whole way through. It felt like being shown around by friends. Highly recommend, and we'd do it again in a heartbeat. Thank you both!
author: Luz_V
